name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 29 - Am 38
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 29e. Calls for legal and social protection measures to be put in place to ensure the full protection of primary residences, including a general moratorium on mortgage enforcement, forced evictions and auctions, as well as accessible support mechanisms, in order to protect citizens from unjust or avoidable repossession of their primary residences when homeowners are unable to repay their mortgages due to proven financial hardship; strongly condemns the sale of mortgage loans to funds and the subsequent unfair commercial practices, including abusive conduct towards borrowers, which frequently results in aggressive debt recovery practices and loss of protections for borrowers and guarantors, and calls for a legal prohibition of such transfers;
